task.name: Issue Label Policy Enforcement
task.description: Review newly opened repository issues and surface only issues that are missing one required triage label from a defined operator policy such as area, priority, or type.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent manually finding untriaged issues while avoiding duplicate attention on issues whose missing-label state is already tracked or explicitly waived.
activationConditions: A new issue is opened within the evidence window in a repository covered by the workflow policy.
Authoritative repository issue evidence shows the issue lacks at least one required triage label category defined by the policy.
requiredEffects: Each novel finding identifies the issue, the missing required label category, and the policy evidence used to determine the omission.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: Every newly opened covered issue already has all required triage label categories.
Every supported missing-label finding for the newly opened covered issues is already tracked or explicitly waived.
successConditions: Supported missing-label findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within the evidence window.
Issues that already satisfy the label policy create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A repository may intentionally exempt a small class of issues from one label category through documented policy exceptions.
One issue may omit more than one required label category and therefore produce more than one supported finding.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel missing-label findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 7 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported missing-label findings it assigns for newly opened covered issues.
acceptedEvidence: A repository issue timeline showing the required triage label was added to the identified issue before the evidence cutoff.
A closed tracking issue or issue conversation that explicitly marks the finding resolved, dismissed, or waived by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-missing-label-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported findings / supported novel findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 7 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel missing-label finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set or required repository issue evidence for newly opened covered issues cannot be read.
